name: Samchully Co.,Ltd
summary: Samchully Co.,Ltd. engages in the supplying of natural gas in South Korea and the United States. It is involved in the operation of compressed natural gas (CNG) stations for natural gas vehicles; and energy audit businesses. The company also generates and supplies electricity for Korea Power Exchange. In addition, it engages in piping and cooling/heating works; car dealership activities; plumbing and cooling/heating equipment wholesale business; supplying of steam, hot and cold water, and air conditioning products; waste disposal business; investment, consulting, etc. activities; food and hotel businesses; and production, transportation, and sale of energy.
